_README: Dated market facts shown as negotiation context. Each entry carries its source. All were read via search excerpts on 2026-10-02 (publisher pages were not directly fetchable); spot-check before external use.

facts.text: Sandhills used tractors 100 HP+ (US): inventory -15.49% Y/Y; asking -0.09% Y/Y; auction about +4.45% Y/Y (series label unconfirmed in the excerpt); asking sits 31% above auction (EVI spread).
Sandhills used tractors 100 HP+: inventory -16.75% Y/Y (14 straight months down); auction values +2.97% Y/Y; asking sits 33% above auction.

Tractor Zoom: 4WD is 'the category most exposed to price sensitive buyers pulling back'; inventory -11% Y/Y, aged (360+ days) -4.4% Y/Y, values still trending down. Sandhills publishes no separate 4WD series.
Sandhills used combines: inventory -10.18% Y/Y; auction values +4.66% Y/Y, asking +1.46% Y/Y. Asking ran 38-40% above auction in spring 2026.
Sandhills used planters: auction values +15.3% Y/Y (+5.1% M/M), the strongest category; asking +6.4% Y/Y. Auction is rising faster than asking.
Sandhills used sprayers: largest auction-value drop of any category in July (about -4% M/M; -5.1% Y/Y). Tractor Zoom (June 2026): supply and 360+-day aged inventory both -27% Y/Y.
